title: 🔮 PRISM webhook trigger payload
description: Schema for trigger_data.payload as sent by Fresh Catch, one POST per company per rep. See design-spec.md §6.1.

report_id.description: Fresh Catch's run_id — company-level lineage key.

owning_rep_rox_user_id.description: Must equal runtime {{ metadata.user.id }} or PRISM aborts with BLOCKED:rep_mismatch.

signal_summary.description: Fresh Catch's summary of why the company surfaced.

rox_company_id.description: Optional. Skips domain lookup if Fresh Catch already resolved the account.

test.description: Optional. If truthy: run diagnostic only, no claim/sequence writes.

signal_type.description: Optional. Fresh Catch's classification, e.g. product_launch, funding.

fresh_catch_couchbase_angle.description: Optional. Prior category-level Couchbase angle. Treat as prior work, not gospel.

fresh_catch_call_opener.description: Optional. Prior suggested opener. Same treatment as fresh_catch_couchbase_angle.

pursuit_id.description: Fresh Catch's stable per-contact key, format fc-YYYYMMDD-{initials}-{6-hex}. PRISM promotes the selected primary's pursuit_id to its claim.

rox_person_id.description: Optional. If Fresh Catch already resolved the person in Rox.

is_fresh_catch_primary.description: Optional. Fresh Catch's own primary guess. Advisory only — PRISM's cheap triage (step 3) and deep-research classifier (step 6) can override it.
